question.text: How will the Agit Kabayel vs. Nelson Hysa fight end on November 28, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the way the boxing match ends between Agit Kabayel and Nelson Hysa, currently scheduled for Saturday, November 28, 2026. Please note that "other outcome" includes any other outcome, including a Hysa victory, a draw, or the boxing match for any reason not being held before November 29, 2026 (local time).

research:
I could not find any report that settles this question. As of 2026-10-28, mainstream German and English coverage still has the fight on for November 28. The bookmakers make Kabayel a huge favourite. I found no prices for how or in which round the fight ends. A few low-profile sites claim Hysa has withdrawn, but I could not confirm that.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names no official data source. In practice it will be the official result: the WBC, the promoter Queensberry/DAZN, and BoxRec or Wikipedia afterwards. The background DAZN article and the box.live, Tapology and BoxingScene pages all returned 403 errors, so I could not read them.
- 2026-10-29: Wikipedia lists Kabayel at 27-0 (19 KOs), WBC heavyweight champion since June 2026, with his first defence against Hysa set for 28 Nov 2026 at the Merkur Spiel-Arena, Düsseldorf. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agit_Kabayel)

## 2. Current status
- The fight has not happened and nothing settles the question yet.
- About 1 month old, date unverified: two low-quality aggregator sites say "Nelson Hysa withdraws" and that Frank Warren will name a replacement. Neither loaded, and no major outlet confirms it. [geregistreedengod](https://geregistreedengod.com/article/agit-kabayel-s-title-defense-in-limbo-as-nelson-hysa-withdraws), [kumacharmers](https://kumacharmers.com/article/agit-kabayel-s-wbc-title-defense-a-tale-of-missed-opportunities-and-unanswered-questions)
  - These may be recycled stories from an earlier date. Tapology's page for the January 2026 "Kabayel vs. Knyba: The Homecoming" event has "kabayel-vs-hysa" in its address. That suggests Hysa was once lined up for January and replaced by Knyba, but I could not confirm it. [Tapology](https://www.tapology.com/fightcenter/events/134104-kabayel-vs-hysa)
- 2026-10-28: Bild says the fight is still on: DAZN has signed Henry Maske as an analyst, and over 40,000 tickets are sold. [Bild](https://www.bild.de/sport/mehr-sport/boxen-tv-hammer-um-henry-maske-enthuellt-6ae2041221fd087fed7ed7e9)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-28: SI also lists Kabayel-Hysa as part of German boxing's "biggest weekend," November 27-28. [SI](https://www.si.com/fannation/boxing/german-boxing-s-biggest-weekend-begins-with-two-european-heavyweight-title-fights)
- 2026-10-07: Ring Magazine lists Hysa at 25-0 (23 KOs). His last fight was a second-round stoppage of Thomas Narmo on Aug 29, and the article says he has "no notable opponents." Kabayel will have been out 10 months. Ticket sales were 35,000 plus 5,000 more released. Warren says the winner will chase unification fights in 2027. The article says the fight "nearly didn't happen" but gives no reason. [Ring](https://www.ringmagazine.com/news/kabayel-promises-better-version-before-hysa-defense-on-nov-28-5AhsAvDXFLlSFsyUda5HPx)
- 2026-10-06: Boxing247 describes Hysa as 42 years old and WBC #18 (outside the top 15). His wins include Narmo, Pesut, Korte and Castillo. It calls the matchup one with "little reason to expect a competitive fight." [Boxing247](https://www.boxing247.com/boxing-news/agit-kabayel-vs-nelson-hysa-offers-little-intrigue/310339)
- 2026-10-04: The fight is announced for Düsseldorf on DAZN. [Fightnews](https://fightnews.com/kabayel-vs-hysa-in-dusseldorf-on-november-28/197494), [Queensberry](https://queensberry.co.uk/blogs/queensberry-promotions-blog/kabayel-v-hysa-booked-for-world-title-showdown-in-dusseldorf-live-on-dazn)

## 4. Base rates

| 2026-01 | Knyba | TKO round 3 |

- In those 10 fights:
  - 4 were stoppages in rounds 1-3.
  - 2 were stoppages in rounds 4-6.
  - 1 was a stoppage in rounds 7-12.
  - 3 went to a decision, all in 2021 or earlier.
- His last 6 fights were all stoppages.
- Over his whole career: 19 KOs and 8 decisions in 27 wins.
- Hysa has 23 KOs in 25 wins against weak opposition. His age (42 per Boxing247 and Bild) is a factor. I could not check his birth date independently.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Moneyline prices only; I found no method-of-victory or round-betting prices:
  - FanDuel: Kabayel -1800, Hysa +900. [FanDuel](https://sportsbook.fanduel.com/boxing/boxing-matches/agit-kabayel-v-nelson-hysa-36140224)

- I found no Polymarket or Manifold market on this fight.

forecasts.reasoning:
**(a) Time left:** About 30 days. The fight is on November 28, 2026, and the result will be known that night (around 2026-11-29 00:00 UTC).

**(b) Status quo:** The fight goes ahead as scheduled and Kabayel, a 27-0 WBC champion, beats a 42-year-old, untested Hysa. Kabayel's last six fights all ended in stoppages, so a stoppage is the default expectation.

**(c) Base rates:**
- **Kabayel's last 10 fights:** 4 stoppages in rounds 1-3, 2 in rounds 4-6, 1 in rounds 7-12, and 3 decisions (all in 2021 or earlier).
- **Stoppage timing:** As a body puncher he often breaks opponents down mid-fight.
- **Cancellations:** Heavyweight title fights that are on a month out still fall through, through injury, withdrawal or replacement, roughly 5-10% of the time.
- **Upsets:** A 1/20 favourite loses about 4-6% of the time.

**(d) Strongest evidence:**
- **Betting (current):** Moneylines of -1800 to -2000 imply about 93-95% for Kabayel. Tapology community picks are 100% Kabayel.
- **Fight still on (2026-10-28):** Bild and SI confirm the fight is going ahead, with over 40,000 tickets sold and DAZN broadcast plans set.
- **Opponent quality (Oct 6-7):** Ring and Boxing247 put Hysa at 25-0 (23 KOs) but against weak opposition, aged 42, ranked WBC #18. Both outlets expect a mismatch.
- **Withdrawal rumours:** Unverified aggregator stories say Hysa has withdrawn. They are probably recycled from the January 2026 event, when Knyba replaced him. They still add a little cancellation risk.

**(e) Unexpected scenario:** Hysa withdraws during fight week with an injury and Queensberry brings in a replacement, which resolves as "Other." Alternatively, a ring-rusty Kabayel, after 10 months out, gets caught by a heavy-handed puncher early.

**Reasoning:**
- **Starting point:** I start from about 93% for a Kabayel win and reduce it to about 87% for the cancellation or replacement risk. That leaves 13% for "Other": roughly 5-6% for a Hysa win, 6-7% for cancellation or replacement, and about 1% for a draw or no contest.
- **Kabayel's 87%:** A stoppage is very likely, about 80% of his wins, given his form and an aged, untested opponent. Early rounds are favoured because Hysa has never faced this level of opponent, but Kabayel's usual body-attack pattern also puts real weight on rounds 4-6.
